record.headline: Datadog Cloud SIEM now says workflows triggered from security findings and signals are free, while workflows started by other triggers are still billed separately.
rows: Workflows triggered from security findings and signals
record.who: Cloud SIEM customers who run Workflow Automation from security findings and signals.
record.read: Datadog appears to be removing a cost barrier to automated response inside its security products. The same wording shows up on its Cloud Security Management page, so this looks like one move across the security line.
record.caveat: Source text only says the workflows are free; it gives no start date. Other triggers stay billed.

record.headline: Datadog Cloud Security Management now gives unlimited free Workflow Automation executions when triggered from security findings and signals, in place of metered allotments of 5 (CSM Pro) and 20 (CSM Enterprise) per host per month.

record.read: Removing the cap makes automated remediation free to scale, which probably aims to pull more security teams into Datadog workflows. It only covers security-triggered runs, so other workflow use still looks metered.
record.caveat: A second PricingSaaS report for Synthetic Testing carries the same 5 and 20 figures, so the numbers may be shared across several Datadog security products.

record.read: This looks like a reversal of the previous week's change, which had removed Essentials and raised Pro and Premium. A cheaper entry plan plus lower upper tiers suggests 7shifts is trading price for volume or is still testing its ladder.
